scripts.dev: npm run build-php --silent && wrangler dev --config examples/demo/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build-php --silent && wrangler deploy --config examples/demo/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.build-feup: bash build/build-feup.sh && workers-php build ./feup-ltw-proj --out ./feup-ltw-proj/dist --docroot . --entrypoint router.php && bash build/build-feup-static.sh
scripts.dev:feup: npm run build-feup --silent && wrangler dev --config feup-ltw-proj/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:feup: npm run build-feup --silent && wrangler deploy --config feup-ltw-proj/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.feup:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute xaufome-db --config feup-ltw-proj/wrangler.jsonc --local --file=feup-ltw-proj/database/schema/create.sql && wrangler d1 execute xaufome-db --config feup-ltw-proj/wrangler.jsonc --local --file=feup-ltw-proj/database/schema/triggers.sql && wrangler d1 execute xaufome-db --config feup-ltw-proj/wrangler.jsonc --local --file=feup-ltw-proj/database/schema/populate.sql
scripts.feup:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute xaufome-db --config feup-ltw-proj/wrangler.jsonc --remote --file=feup-ltw-proj/database/schema/create.sql && wrangler d1 execute xaufome-db --config feup-ltw-proj/wrangler.jsonc --remote --file=feup-ltw-proj/database/schema/triggers.sql && wrangler d1 execute xaufome-db --config feup-ltw-proj/wrangler.jsonc --remote --file=feup-ltw-proj/database/schema/populate.sql
scripts.build-bindings: workers-php build ./examples/bindings-demo --out ./examples/bindings-demo/dist --docroot . --entrypoint router.php && cp -a examples/bindings-demo/style examples/bindings-demo/dist/style && cp -a examples/bindings-demo/assets examples/bindings-demo/dist/assets 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev:bindings: npm run build-bindings --silent && wrangler dev --config examples/bindings-demo/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:bindings: npm run build-bindings --silent && wrangler deploy --config examples/bindings-demo/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev:laravel: npm run build:laravel --silent && wrangler dev --config examples/laravel/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:laravel: npm run build:laravel --silent && wrangler deploy --config examples/laravel/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev:slim: npm run build:slim --silent && wrangler dev --config examples/slim/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:slim: npm run build:slim --silent && wrangler deploy --config examples/slim/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.build:symfony: bash build/build-framework.sh examples/symfony public sh -c 'rm -rf var/cache var/log'
scripts.dev:symfony: npm run build:symfony --silent && wrangler dev --config examples/symfony/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:symfony: npm run build:symfony --silent && wrangler deploy --config examples/symfony/wrangler.jsonc
